mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% for three consecutive months signals severe labor market deterioration that triggers corporate cost-cutting and reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 9.0% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 90.0 indicates severe supply chain disruption that reduces manufacturing output and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 90.0, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer spending that boosts corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS rises but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Core inflation exceeding 3.0% for two consecutive months signals persistent inflation that triggers Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate increases and employment declines (PAYEMS) indicate labor market deterioration that reduces consumer confidence and corporate hiring, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth declining below 1.0% annualized signals economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 < 1.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03.
